glosses: A shot taken at an easy or random target.

examples.text: Bannister leaped up, ran lightly across the intervening space, and with his repeater took a potshot at the galloping horseman.

glosses: Criticism of an easy target; a cheap shot.

examples.text: He takes his share of potshots (mostly at the Da Vinci surgical robot), but the conscience of the film is in the stories of Essure, a procedure marketed to women as a hassle-free alternative to tubal ligation

And until recently, anyone could read his Facebook posts, which included vulgar potshots at Nancy Pelosi and her husband and a pronouncement that supporters of Joseph R. Biden Jr. suffered from a “mental affliction.”

translations.source_sense_description: shot at an easy target or at random

examples.text: „Er parierte die Stöße mit seinem langen Korbdegen oder wich ihnen mit wunderbarer Behendigkeit aus, führte auch zwischendurch einmal einen Seitenhieb auf seine Gegner.“

glosses: Kritik, spöttische Bemerkung, die nicht Hauptinhalt der Äußerung ist

examples.text: „Einen Seitenhieb auf die Schwesterpartei konnte sich Huber nicht verkneifen und beklagte, es habe keinen Rückenwind aus der Bundespolitik gegeben.“

Howard appeared in the doorway. “Say, Sig, go down to the corral and saddle up Teddy for Steve, will you? Some of his friends have been potshotting at him again. No damage done, except to my feelings, but there's nothing like being careful.”

glosses: strzał przypadkowy, oddany nieostrożnie lub do łatwego celu

examples.text: A sniper was on the roof taking potshots at passing cars.
examples.translation: Snajper z dachu strzelał do przejeżdżających samochodów jak do kaczek.

glosses: krytyka (zwłaszcza w mass mediach) dokonana bez należytej staranności lub uzasadnienia

examples.text: The mayor was a subject of hefty potshot from his opponents.
examples.translation: Burmistrz był przedmiotem gwałtownych ataków ze strony swoich przeciwników.

glosses: （随意的或朝简单目标的）射击
（对简单目标的）批评，抨击，中伤

examples.text: He takes his share of potshots (mostly at the Da Vinci surgical robot), but the conscience of the film is in the stories of Essure, a procedure marketed to women as a hassle-free alternative to tubal ligation
